hooks.command: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$root" ] && [ -f "$root/.claude/hooks/on_edit.py" ]; then python3 "$root/.claude/hooks/on_edit.py"; fi
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$root" ] && [ -f "$root/.claude/hooks/bash_guard.py" ]; then python3 "$root/.claude/hooks/bash_guard.py"; fi
